newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Healthcare says firm not hired.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Healthcare says firm not hired.

text.p: Integrated Healthcare Systems Inc said Wednesday that it actually had not hired the investment banking firm of Robertson Stephens & Co as it had announced earlier in the day.
Integrated Healthcare had earlier in the day said it had hired the firm to review possible merger or acquisition candidates, and said that talks has begun with two such companies.
But Wednesday night, the company issued another statement said it has not retained Robertson Stephens. It said it is in the selection process for a financial adviser and investment banker.
Integrated Healthcare did not immediately return a telephone call seeking further information. Robertson Stephens was not immediately available.
Integrated designs, develops, markets and maintains integrated data warehouse software for the healthcare industry.
